definitions.unit: Completed offensive possessions by the original seven receiving-point players.
definitions.cutoff: Stop at the first recorded personnel change, incomplete lineup update, or named passer/catcher outside the opening seven. Keep completed possessions before that event; never resume or renumber the sequence.
definitions.partial: A possession crossing the cutoff is omitted from the completed-possession scoring denominator. Earlier physical throws remain preserved in the audit and original source, without assigning the replacement line outcome to them.
definitions.timeout: The earlier exclusion of possessions containing timeout events 3 or 5 remains in the main comparison. A prior timeout alone is not exclusion: later possessions count only if records still support the same seven. This is tested separately from timeout caller.
definitions.unknown: Incomplete opening lineups and contradictory named players are excluded. Unknown actor IDs alone are flagged rather than treated as substitutions when the lineup records remain complete.
definitions.outcome: Goal / (goal + turnover). Period endings are excluded and retained as a sensitivity calculation; no removal of near-goal starts.
definitions.selection: All eligible opening possessions are the baseline, including points with a later substitution. Later rates are conditional on reaching that possession with the original seven.
definitions.limit: Recorded personnel continuity is not independent film verification of every substitution. Unrecorded changes or incorrect source lineups can remain undetected.
definitions.inference: Exploratory update. Observed ranges resample whole games 10000 times, seed 20261113; adjusted ranges use the prior context formula with game-clustered covariance. Updated scoring contrasts are not covered by the old multi-metric Holm results; team_changes includes its own 22-team Holm adjustment.

second_to_third_or_later.role: Exploratory follow-up; not a primary first-versus-subsequent contrast.

model.formula: C(stage, levels=[1,2,3]) + bs(first_y, df=5, degree=3, include_intercept=False) + bs(abs_x, df=3, degree=2, include_intercept=False) + C(team) + C(opponent) + C(quarter) + point_remaining
regained * C(team) + bs(first_y, df=5, degree=3, include_intercept=False) + bs(abs_x, df=3, degree=2, include_intercept=False) + C(team) + C(opponent) + C(quarter) + point_remaining

team_changes.note: Field/context-adjusted first vs all subsequent possessions. Within-team t reference uses team game count minus one; Holm correction across 22 teams within this metric. Few games per team remain a limitation.
